title: Screenshot Waypoints
description: Automatically geotag Minecraft screenshots with coords/biome/dimension/yaw-pitch and browse them in an in-game gallery.
body:
# Screenshot Waypoints 📸

![Gallery](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/709aabf9f67bd8d2b33293fc52a18ee58fda04df.png)

Automatically geotag your Minecraft screenshots with:

- **Coordinates** (X/Y/Z)
- **Biome**
- **Dimension**
- **Camera angle** (Yaw/Pitch)
- **World / server name**
- **Timestamp**

The mod also includes an in-game **Screenshot Gallery** to browse screenshots and quickly access/copy location data.

## Features ✨

- **Automatic geotagging** when taking a screenshot.
- **Two storage modes**:
  - **PNG (recommended):** stores metadata inside the screenshot as a PNG text chunk (iTXt/tEXt).
  - **JSON:** stores metadata as a sidecar file next to the screenshot (`.png` + `.json`).
- **Screenshot Gallery**:
  - Preview selected screenshots
  - Show geotag info (biome, dimension, coords, yaw/pitch, timestamp, server/world)
  - **Copy coordinates** to clipboard
  - **Open screenshots folder**
  - **Rename screenshots** (renames the sidecar too in JSON mode)
  - **Filtering** by date range, world/server, biome
- **Mod Menu config screen** (if Mod Menu is installed).
- **Fully localized UI** (English + Russian).

## How to use 🎮

- **Take screenshots:** press Minecraft’s default screenshot key (`F2`).
- **Open the gallery:** use the mod’s keybind (configurable in Controls).
- **Copy coords / open folder:** use the buttons at the bottom of the gallery.

## Configuration ⚙️

You can configure what metadata is written and where it is stored:

- Storage mode: `PNG` or `JSON`
- Enable/disable writing:
  - Coordinates
  - Yaw/Pitch
  - Biome
  - Dimension
  - World/server name
- Gallery entry limit (max screenshots shown)

If Mod Menu is installed, you can open the config screen from the Mods menu.

## Compatibility ✅

- **Minecraft:** 1.20.1
- **Loader:** Fabric
- **Required:** Fabric API
- **Optional:** Mod Menu (for config UI)

## Notes / Privacy 🔐

This mod stores your in-game location inside screenshots (either embedded in the PNG or in a `.json` file).

- If you share screenshots publicly, **be aware that coordinates may be included**.
- You can disable individual fields (coords/biome/etc.) in the config.

## FAQ ❓

### Why does the gallery show “No geotag data” for old screenshots?
Only screenshots taken after installing/enabling the mod will have metadata. For older screenshots, you can retake them or keep them untagged.

### Which storage mode should I use?
- Use **PNG** if you want a single self-contained image file.
- Use **JSON** if you prefer external metadata files or want easy manual editing.

---

## Русский (кратко)

**Screenshot Waypoints** автоматически добавляет к скриншотам координаты/биом/измерение/угол камеры и показывает всё это в удобной галерее.

- Хранение метаданных: **внутри PNG** или **в sidecar JSON**
- Галерея: предпросмотр, фильтры, переименование, копирование координат, открытие папки
- Настройки через **Mod Menu** (если установлен)
